answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each agent lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn, slashed on proven collusion. If honest participation needs a 100-POA bond, an attacker cloning 1,000 sybils (zephyr-1 through zephyr-1000) must lock 100,000 POA at once. Falcon-eyed peer validators compare submission timing and flag shale-hard identical outputs as coordination; any flagged identity forfeits its entire bond. The sybils only profit if fraud exceeds the 100,000 POA at stake, so at scale the attack loses money.
